article.headline: Ruth puts up 25 in Stonehill’s 95-82 victory against Northeastern
article.description: — Trenton Ruth’s 25 points helped Stonehill defeat Northeastern 95-82 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Ruth puts up 25 in Stonehill’s 95-82 victory against Northeastern
article.story: NORTH EASTON, Mass. ( -- — Trenton Ruth’s 25 points helped Stonehill defeat Northeastern 95-82 on Saturday. Ruth shot 5 for 10 (3 for 6 from 3-point range) and 12 of 12 from the free-throw line for the Skyhawks (2-4). Devon Arlington scored 18 points while going 5 of 14 from the floor, including 4 for 7 from 3-point range, and 4 for 4 from the line, and added nine assists. Pearse McGuinn had 11 points and finished 4 of 6 from the field. Rashad King finished with 21 points for the Huskies (2-4). Louis Bond added 20 points for Northeastern. Mike Loughnane also had 13 points. Stonehill took the lead for good with 13:30 remaining in the first half. The score was 49-40 at halftime, with Anquan Boldin Jr. racking up 10 points. Stonehill pulled away with a 9-2 run in the second half to extend an eight-point lead to 15 points. They outscored Northeastern by four points in the final half, as Ruth led the way with a team-high 19 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
